location.title: Location while you are online
location.body: While you are online, Mondapac Courier shares your location with dispatch so we can offer you nearby deliveries and show customers where their order is. It keeps doing this when the app is in the background or the screen is off. Sharing stops as soon as you go offline.
location.android: On the next screens choose "While using the app", then "Allow all the time". A notification shows while your location is being shared.
location.ios: On the next screens choose "Allow While Using App", then "Change to Always Allow".
location.denied: Location access is off. Open Settings and allow location "All the time" to go online.
location.iosAlways: While you are online, your location is shared with dispatch to offer you nearby deliveries and show customers their order's progress, also in the background. Sharing stops when you go offline.
location.iosWhenInUse: Your location is used to offer you nearby deliveries and to navigate to pickups and drop-offs.
location.notificationBody: Sharing your location with Mondapac dispatch.
